spans.s:
mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
A giver, giving, bountiful.
f. (-दा)
A gift, a donation.
E.
प्र before दा to give, and श aff. or अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं)
Reverential salutation, by circumambulating a person or object, keeping the right side towards them.
E.
प्र before दक्षिण the right.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Given, bestowed, conferred.
E.
प्र before दत्त given.

m. (-रः)
1 Splitting, rending, tearing.
2 Fracture, a breaking.
3 A disease of women, (Mænorrhagia.)
4 An arrow.
E.
प्र intensitive, दृ to tear, aff. अप्.

m. (-कः)
1 A teacher, an expounder.
2 A prophet.
E.
प्र before दर्शक who shews.

Shewing.
2

Explaining generally, not exclusively.
3 Explaining or specifying.
4 Prophesying.
E.
प्र before दृश to see, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Mentioned, specified.
2

Shewn.
3

Prophesied.
E.
प्र before दृश to see, and क्त aff.

m. (-लः)
An arrow.
E.
प्र before दल to tear, or the र of प्रदर changed to ल.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Who or what annoys, distresses, &c.
E.
दु to annoy, with प्र prefix, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
A donor, who or what gives.
E.
प्र before दा to give, तृच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Gift, donation.
2 A goad.
E.
प्र before दा to give, or दो to cut, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Smeared, anointed.
m. (-ग्धः)
A kind of sauce or gravy.
E.
प्र before दिग्ध smeared.

f. (-दिक्)
Intermediate point of the compass, or half quarter, as north-east, south-west, &c.
E.
प्र implying division, and दिश् a point or quarter.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Appointed, directed.
E.
प्र before दिश to shew, क्त aff.

m. (-पः)
A lamp.
E.
प्र before दीप to shine, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 Inflaming, illuminating.
2 Stimulating, exciting, who or what does so.
n. (-नं)
The act of inflaming, exciting, &c.
m. (-नः)
A sort of mineral poison, of a red colour, and caustic operation.
E.
प्र before दीप to inflame, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Kindled, burning.
2 Excited, stimulated.
E.
प्र before दीप to inflame, क्त aff.

mfn. (-घुक्)
Who or what milks much or well.
E.
प्र before दुह to milk, क्विप् aff.

n. (-यं)
A gift.
E.
प्र before देय to be given.

m. (-शः)
1 A place in general, a country, a district, &c.
2 A foreign country, abroad.
3 A short span, measured from the tip of the thumb to that of the forefinger.
4 A wall.
E.
प्र before देश place.

m. (-शः)
1 The span of the thumb and forefinger.
2 Place, country.
E.
प्र before दिश to shew, aff. घञ्; whence the vowel of the prefix is optionally long: see प्रदेश.

n. (-नं)
A gift, a present, a bribe or offering, any thing given to the gods, to superiors, or friends, &c.
f. (-नी)
The forefinger.
E.
प्र before दिश to show, aff ल्युट्, fem. aff. ङीप्.

n. (-नं)
Gift, donation.
E.
प्र and आङ् before दिश to give, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-नी)
The forefinger.
E.
प्र before दिश to shew, aff. णिनि, fem. aff. ङीप्.

m. (-हः)
Unguent, unction.
E.
प्र before दिह to plaster, aff. घज्.

m. (-षः)
1 Evening, the first part of the night.
2 Fault, offence, defect, transgression.
E.
प्र implying commencement, &c. and दोष fault.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Belonging, or relating to the evening.
E.
प्रदोष evening, aff. अण्; also with ठञ् aff. प्रादोषिक.

n. adv. (-द्यु)
Heavenly, holy, securing heaven.
E.
प्र before द्यु for द्युस् heaven.

m. (-म्नः)
KĀMA, the Hindū CUPID, reborn as the son of KṚṢṆA.
E.
प्र pre-eminent, द्यम्न power.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Illuminated, irradiated.
E.
प्र before द्यु to shine, क्त aff. and the vowel unchanged; also प्रद्योतित.

m. (-तः)
1 A ray of light.
2 Light, lustre.
E.
प्र excess, and द्योत shining.

m. (-नः)
The sun.
n. (-नं)
Blazing, shining, light.
E.
प्र excess, द्युत to shine, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Illuminated, lighted.
E.
प्र before द्यु to shine, क्त aff.; also प्रद्युदित.

m. (-वः)
1 Flight, retreat, running away.
2 Going, going quick or well.
E.
प्र before द्रु to go, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Who retreats, flies, goes, &c.
E.
प्र before द्रु to go, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-द्विट्)
Who hates or dislikes, hostile, inimical.
E.
प्र before द्विष to hate, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षती-षत्)
Hating, hostile, an enemy.
E.
प्र, and द्विषत् a foe.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
Who hates or dislikes.
E.
प्र before द्विव to hate, तृच् aff.

n. (-ण्यं)
Circumambulation.
E.
प्रदक्षिण, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-वः)
Appearance, manifestation.
E.
प्राटुम्, and भाव quality.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Manifested, made apparent.
E.
प्राटुस, and कृत made.

ind.
1 Evidently, apparently, manifestly.
2 Visible, apparent.
3 Name, appellation.
4

Existence.
5

Co-existence.
E.
प्र before अद to go, or eat, Uṇādi aff. उस्.
